hooks.command: mkdir -p .claude/sessions && f=".claude/sessions/$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo nogit).md" && { echo "# Session summary - $(date -Iseconds)"; echo; echo "- Branch: $(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)"; echo "- HEAD: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)"; echo; echo "## Changed files (git status)"; echo '```'; git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null; echo '```'; echo; echo "## Recent commits"; echo '```'; git log --oneline -10 2>/dev/null; echo '```'; } > "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
